title: Projects
description: Projects across work and home that share one pattern: build a system, not a one-off, and leave behind durable artifacts and memory.

title: Research Roots
description: Where I started: web-content credibility and crowdsourced quality assessment at PJAIT, the thread to LLM-as-arbiter systems, and a short reading log.

title: Michał Kąkol
description: Hands-on data science manager and AI systems builder. I help people make progress when systems get too complex to hold in their heads.

title: The interesting unit is not the prompt. It is the workspace.
description: Prompts are disposable; the durable, agent-readable workspace is the real unit. Plus the failure mode nobody demos: presence is not use.

title: Experimentation as an error-surfacing system
description: A p=5e-6 result that collapsed to p=0.59 once three plausible errors came off — and why trust is an error-surfacing system, not a feeling.

title: The Return of the Homepage
description: Why I built a plain homepage in 2026 instead of living on platforms: ownership, a deliberate filter, a retro surface over modern guts.

title: Am I Still a Data Scientist?
description: From data scientist to manager to AI-native builder: the honest maker-vs-manager tension, and the one thread that actually runs through all of it.

title: The Shame of Using AI
description: The shame of letting a model write the draft is aimed at the wrong thing. The value was never the typing — it's the loop, the verification, the memory.
